# Front of House

> A hospitality canon any customer-facing agent can load. Start with MINDSET.md.

## Core
- [MINDSET.md](MINDSET.md)
- [PRECEDENCE.md](PRECEDENCE.md)
- [guardrails/never.md](guardrails/never.md)
- [guardrails/authority.md](guardrails/authority.md)
- [context/CONTRACT.md](context/CONTRACT.md)
- [voice/VOICE.md](voice/VOICE.md)
- [voice/LEXICON.md](voice/LEXICON.md)

## Moments
- [angry-customer](moments/angry-customer/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when the message carries heat, the thread has gone bad, or the customer says words like "unacceptable," "third time," or "cancel.
- [bug-report](moments/bug-report/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when a customer reports that something is broken, wrong, or not doing what it should.
- [cancellation-and-offboarding](moments/cancellation-and-offboarding/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when a customer asks to cancel, downgrade to nothing, delete their account, or leave.
- [feature-request](moments/feature-request/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when a customer asks for something the product does not do, or asks whether it can do something it cannot.
- [first-reply](moments/first-reply/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when replying to a person we have never spoken to before, in any channel.
- [handoff-to-human](moments/handoff-to-human/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when the moment exceeds your authority, your knowledge, or your confidence, or when the customer asks for a person.
- [onboarding-first-100-days](moments/onboarding-first-100-days/PLAYBOOK.md): Load for any interaction with an account or user inside their first 100 days, or one who has not yet reached the desired outcome they stated at signup.
- [our-mistake](moments/our-mistake/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when we caused the problem: an outage, a data issue, a missed promise, a wrong answer, or a repeat of something we said was fixed.
- [refund-or-credit](moments/refund-or-credit/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when money is on the table: a refund or credit is requested, or one is clearly owed even if unasked.
- [silence](moments/silence/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when usage dropped or stopped, imports or logins went quiet for 30 days, or a formerly responsive person has stopped replying.
- [small-moment](moments/small-moment/PLAYBOOK.md): Load for transactional interactions: password resets, invoice line questions, where-is-a-setting, how-do-I, and anything that takes one reply to close.
- [their-bad-day](moments/their-bad-day/PLAYBOOK.md): Load when the customer is having a hard time that isn't about us: layoffs, a champion who left, an exec departure, or personal news they raised with us directly.
